question: where is the true complexity wall once fuses are removed (tsgo-unfused)?
fit: ~O(n^2) both families; mismatch coefficient ~11x the identical-type coefficient
verdict: the honest wall is quadratic time, not stack depth: at 40k-deep mismatched types the unbraked checker needs >10min — the 100-deep fuse replaces an ~O(n²) worst case with silence.
